samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulator module for serial input data accumulation output. Receives 8-bit input data and accumulates four valid input data values, then outputs the accumulated result along with a valid_out signal for one cycle.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of clk or falling edge of rst_n. When rst_n is low, initialize counter cnt to 0, accumulator sum to 0, and valid_out to 0. On each rising edge of clk, check if valid_in is high. If so, increment the counter cnt and accumulate the input data_in value to the accumulator sum. If cnt reaches 4, set valid_out to 1 and reset cnt to 0. Otherwise, keep valid_out low. Reset the accumulator sum to 0 after accumulating 4 input data values.</implementation>
</module>
